statement: Iluka Retreat & Camp is in Red Hill South VIC 3937.
note: The headline of this pilot on the address side, and the reason it has a partner on the coordinates side. This corpus already held the operator's own answer: src/data/facts/accommodation.json, entity F012, carries "20 Shoreham Road, Shoreham". The layer with no page and no reader was right; the layer that renders, emits JSON-LD and drives the map was wrong. One claim, two records that assert it, and they disagree - which is the argument for a sidecar registry rather than a provenance field per record, in one venue. Authored by hand for the PI-005 address and coordinates pilot. Sources were read on 2026-09-14; see ops/reports/claims/2026-09-14-pilot-address.md.
